newsitem.title: USA: R.R. Donnelley 10.1 pct stake held.
newsitem.headline: R.R. Donnelley 10.1 pct stake held.

text.p: A group led by Oppenheimer Group Inc said on Monday that it held a 10.1 percent stake in R.R. Donnelley & Sons Co, or 15,482,305 common shares.
The group disclosed its latest position on R.R. Donnelley in a 13G filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. In contrast with 13D filings, those reports do not list the filer's latest transactions.
